ModelDeveloperPrincipalDeclaration.description:
The identity of one developer machine's principal.

The row names who holds the principal and holds no grant: the grants come
from the document's ``grants_source``.

device.title: Device

login.title: Login

principal.description: Broker principal name: lower-case letters, digits and hyphens.
principal.title: Principal

ModelDeveloperPrincipalDeclaration.title: ModelDeveloperPrincipalDeclaration

description:
The developer machines a deployment gives a broker principal.

The document has no field for a grant. The grants of every principal in it
are derived from the declaration ``grants_source`` names, so a grant cannot
be typed into a row and left to drift from that declaration.

grants_source.description: The declaration every principal's grants are derived from.
grants_source.title: Grants Source

principals.description: The developer machines holding a principal.
principals.title: Principals
